prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production transparent NPC animation sprite atlas for a cozy Suzhou watercolor game.
Create a single atlas with EXACTLY 3 columns and 5 rows, 15 full-body sprites total. Portrait canvas 1536 wide by 2560 high. Equal 512x512 cells. Each ROW is ONE distinct adult traveler repeated in THREE animation poses: column 1 relaxed neutral holding luggage, column 2 small traveling gesture described below, column 3 settling gesture midway returning to neutral. Same character, proportions, clothes, bag and planted feet location within all three cells of a row. Every sprite full body, entire luggage and shoes visible. Generous clear gutters, each figure centered in cell, baseline at same relative height. No grid lines, labels or text. Genuinely transparent background, no floor, no shadows.
Style: soft hand-painted storybook watercolor, delicate brown outlines, warm friendly Chinese faces, slightly oversized heads, compact bodies. Modern everyday clothing in muted colors, detailed and polished, not pixel art.
Row 1: young man Xiaocheng, short tousled black hair, ochre jacket over cream shirt, dark trousers, teal backpack worn on BOTH shoulders and small tan crossbody travel bag. Gesture: unfolds a small map at chest height and looks at it, then lowers it.
Row 2: young woman Yutong, dark bob haircut, muted teal cardigan, ivory top, navy trousers, mustard rolling suitcase with handle grasped beside her. Gesture: lifts a paper train ticket to check it, then lowers it.
Row 3: middle-aged man Wenbo, tidy black hair, round glasses, muted blue jacket, tan trousers, burgundy rolling suitcase. Gesture: checks wristwatch while keeping suitcase handle in other hand, then lowers wrist.
Row 4: older woman Meifang, grey bob, coral coat, dark skirt, olive overnight travel bag resting by her feet with handle in one hand. Gesture: friendly small greeting wave to arriving family, then lowers hand.
Row 5: young woman Jiani, black ponytail, lavender hoodie, charcoal trousers, rust backpack and cream tote bag. Gesture: checks small phone for friend's arrival, then lowers phone.
Constraints: exactly five identities, each with exactly three distinct coherent animation poses. Keep luggage in EVERY pose. All 15 sprites individually separated with clean alpha, no scenery or decorative elements.
